identification: Plain 19th-century colonial style dovetailed blanket box / sea chest, 107 x 49 x 49 cm, dark stained exterior with heavy wear, through-dovetailed corners, plinth (skirted) base, cleated lid with breadboard ends, iron ring/drop side handle visible on one end. Interior unfinished, pale timber with a knot; side till removed (only its slots/stubs remain), red painted '11' inside lid. Timber is catalogued cedar; the interior colour and knot suggest it may be pine or mixed softwood, unconfirmed from photos. Ex-Gatenby family per catalogue (Gatenbys are an early Tasmanian Midlands pioneer family, Campbell Town/Ross); no label or name visible.

viewing_check: Confirm red cedar: scratch-free check of the inside and underside for pinkish-red colour, cedar smell and no knots (the knot inside suggests pine in places). Check dovetails are hand-cut, base boards sound, borer and rot, lid splits, hinges original; look for Gatenby name, initials, labels or shipping marks inside lid, underside and ends; note the red '11' inside the lid.
